config.description: B0 candidate 3: per-frame 2D CA-CFAR on |2dfft|^2 (integral-image), 3x3 local-max suppression, MTI static-clutter exclusion (doppler +/-1 around DC), region range filter, count hysteresis. Seated-person energy sits at doppler DC and is intentionally filtered -- this reproduces the official-baseline weak static detection and is direct RQ2 evidence; B0 v1 is a region moving-target detector, M1 owns static occupancy.
config.target_count_policy: in-region point count after MTI (per frame), -1 when unknown/invalid

region_params.note: Nominal installation values from project plan 5.2 (24-24.25 GHz sweep -> 0.6 m resolution). Replace with measured values after real installation. Coarse-granularity risk documented: plan A region spans only ~3-4 bins.
region_params.bin_conversion: bin_lo = floor(region_m[0] / range_resolution_m); bin_hi = ceil(region_m[1] / range_resolution_m); clip to [0, n_range_bins-1]

smoothing: count hysteresis t_on_frames=2 t_off_frames=3 (per-frame CFAR, no temporal window)
